title: WARDIQ item-output record
description: FROZEN M2->M3 item representation contract. Reviewed and accepted by Omar and Hana per docs/HANDOFFS.md acceptance chain (M2 to M3: Omar, Hana, Asmaa). Frozen here means the SHAPE (field names, types, null rules, ranges) is locked, not that every model/version identifier is final -- embedding.provisional_dimension stays true until Eyad/Hayat confirm a model in the cache phase. Breaking changes require a new major version and downstream revalidation (see docs/m2/README.md changelog).

schema_version.description: Version of THIS interface, not of taxonomy.json. Bump on any breaking or additive field change; see versioning rule in docs/m1/item_output_interface.md.

item_id.description: Stable item id, identical to the id used in clean_manifest.csv / garment_manifest.csv. Never regenerated downstream.

source_category_id.description: null only if source_dataset has no category concept at all (not the case for any current source).

common_category.description: null when mapping_status is 'unmapped' or 'not_a_garment'. NOT an approved cross-dataset vocabulary yet -- see docs/m1/item_output_interface.md section 1.

mapping_status.description: Copied verbatim from configs/m1/taxonomy.json's category_map entry for this source_category_id. Never re-derived downstream.

category_schema_version.description: taxonomy.json 'taxonomy_version' this record's category fields were computed against, e.g. '1.0.0'. Lets a consumer detect a stale mapping if taxonomy.json is later revised.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence for common_category. MUST be null until a classifier actually runs -- do not default to 1.0 for source-labeled ground truth and do not default to 0.0 for unmapped. null means 'not computed', not 'zero confidence'.

vocabulary_source.description: null when source_dataset has no attribute concept (Fashion-MNIST, Polyvore). 'fashionpedia_v1_partial' is PROVISIONAL: only 35 of the official 294 attribute names are verified locally (see open item in docs). Do not treat the current ordering as final.

scores.description: null when unavailable_in_source. When present: keys are attribute names from vocabulary_source, in strict ascending alphabetical order (the required attribute-vector ordering -- see docs). Every value is a float in [0,1], or null for not_annotated. A record with attributes.mask says 'not_annotated' for an attribute name MUST have scores[name]=null, never 0.0.

mask.description: Same keys as scores. Value is the missing-value status per attribute: 'present', 'not_annotated', or 'unavailable_in_source'.

model.description: null until a color-extraction model runs. Never fabricate a palette from the raw pixels as a substitute.

palette.description: null until model is set. When present: 1-8 CIELAB swatches, each with a proportion of the garment crop area. Proportions across one record's palette must sum to 1.0 +/- 0.01.

dimension.description: Must be agreed with Hayat before being treated as final. provisional_dimension=true means this number can still change.

provisional_dimension.description: true until Hayat confirms the final embedding dimension in writing. Defaults to true; a consumer must not hard-code array length while this is true.

vector.description: null until embeddings are actually computed. Length must equal 'dimension' when both are non-null.

formality.description: Not populated in M1. Must stay null until a validated source/model exists for it -- never inferred from category or color as a stand-in.

season.description: Not populated in M1. Same rule as formality.

leakage_group_id.description: The grouping unit that must not span splits. For Polyvore this is the part of Omar's group_id BEFORE the ':' (the outfit id) -- never the raw group_id string, which is unique per row and not a leakage group. For Fashionpedia this is the source image id (several annotations share one image and must stay together). null only for sources with no grouping concept at all (Fashion-MNIST: one image = one item, no sharing).
